mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS and UNRATE both improve.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25 basis points.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with sustained GDPC1 increase.
